lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Long ago, there was a poor man. His name was Meng Xin.
lines.chinese: 很久以前，有一个穷人。他的名字叫孟信。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: He had a sick old ox.
lines.chinese: 他有一头生病的老牛。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: One day, Meng Xin was away from home. His nephew sold the ox.
lines.chinese: 一天，孟信离家外出。他的侄子把牛卖了。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Meng Xin came back home. He did not see the ox.
lines.chinese: 孟信回到家。他没看见牛。

lines.speaker: Meng Xin
lines.english: Where is the ox? Did you sell it?
lines.chinese: 牛在哪里？你把它卖了吗？

lines.speaker: Nephew
lines.english: Yes, I did. We needed money for food!
lines.chinese: 是的，我卖了。我们需要钱买食物！

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Meng Xin did not want to sell a sick old ox to others.
lines.chinese: 孟信不想把生病的老牛卖给别人。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: He found the buyer.
lines.chinese: 他找到了买主。

lines.speaker: Meng Xin
lines.english: Did you buy my ox?
lines.chinese: 你买了我的牛吗？

lines.speaker: Buyer
lines.english: Yes, I did.
lines.chinese: 是的，我买了。

lines.speaker: Meng Xin
lines.english: Sorry, I can't sell it to you. It's old and sick.
lines.chinese: 对不起，我不能把它卖给你。它又老又病。

lines.speaker: Buyer
lines.english: It's very kind of you. Thank you.
lines.chinese: 你真是太好了。谢谢你。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Meng Xin got back his sick old ox.
lines.chinese: 孟信取回了他生病的老牛。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: He got a good name too.
lines.chinese: 他也获得了一个好名声。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Sam found a storybook on his way home.
lines.chinese: 萨姆在回家的路上发现了一本故事书。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: He began to read it. It was fun.
lines.chinese: 他开始读起来。它很有趣。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: He put it in his schoolbag. He broke it.
lines.chinese: 他把它放进书包里。他把它弄坏了。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: Oh no, I broke it!
lines.chinese: 哦不，我把它弄坏了！

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Did you see my storybook yesterday?
lines.chinese: 你昨天看见我的故事书了吗？

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: No, I didn't.
lines.chinese: 不，我没有。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Sam did not feel good.
lines.chinese: 萨姆感觉不好。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: He wanted to repair Bobby's book.
lines.chinese: 他想修好波比的书。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: After school, Sam repaired the book carefully.
lines.chinese: 放学后，萨姆仔细地修好了书。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It was not easy, but he tried his best.
lines.chinese: 这不容易，但他尽了最大努力。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Sam went to Bobby's house.
lines.chinese: 萨姆去了波比家。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: I'm sorry. I broke your book.
lines.chinese: 对不起。我弄坏了你的书。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: No, you didn't. I broke it last week!
lines.chinese: 不，不是你。我上周就把它弄坏了！
